competency: C1 stated causes: a description-level cause lifted to an occurrence question through describes links accepted for both descriptions; the links are confirmed and cited through holds steps (slot T-C3)
question: According to the system at T15, what caused occurrence o-trip, and do the describes links that lift the claim (a-surge describes o-surge, a-trip describes o-trip) hold?
justification: s1: cc-surge-trip is causes(a-surge, a-trip), a description-level claim. It answers the occurrence question about o-trip only through describes links the perspective accepts for both descriptions (causes_of §3 Lifting, PLAN §9.3, SB U-2): dl-surge and dl-trip are the system's own links, holding from T1 until superseded. The entry is lifted (lifted True), keeps its own status and its players are descriptions, so level is description. The system's own claim is accepted. Involved occurrences o-surge and o-trip have accepted existence over [T1, T30), so applies is True. cc-rumour (cause a-rumour has no describes link), cc-gossip (cause a-gossip has no link) and cc-spike-trip (dl-spike rejected and denied at the latest knowledge time) do not lift, so there is exactly one entry. s2, s3: holds on the describes contents; each is the system's own assertion from T1 until superseded, so holds is True with support dl-surge / dl-trip (holds §6, supporting when established). Evidence: cc-surge-trip is supporting (judgement accepted, applies True, P-CO-1); the links are supporting through the holds steps. dl-spike is rejected (never support); the other claims are not part of the answer.
uncertainty: Slot T-C3 asks for the links as required evidence; causes_of has no field citing describes-link attestations (§6), so the links are required through explicit holds steps (see ambiguities.md A-05). Status values (ASSERTED) are not expected because the fixture format does not fix the default basis (A-01).

competency: C1 stated causes: a causal claim whose cause is a description with no describes link is answered directly for its own effect description but never lifted to an occurrence question (slot T-C1)

justification: s1: three accepted causal claims name a-trip as effect (cc-surge-trip, cc-rumour, cc-spike-trip); asked about a-trip itself they answer directly, so none is lifted (causes_of §2 lifted: True only through a describes link). cc-gossip names the sibling description a-trip-2 and is not transferred (one hop, SB 'Scope of causal claims'). cc-rumour is the system's own claim: judgement accepted; both players are descriptions: level description. No occurrence involved in it is denied or disputed (a-rumour describes nothing; o-trip is accepted), so applies is True by the stated rule 'True otherwise'. s2: lifting needs accepted describes links for both descriptions (§3 Lifting, bold 'for both descriptions'); a-rumour has none (v0.2 §3.2: a description with no usable describes link is about no known occurrence), so cc-rumour is absent; only cc-surge-trip lifts (see C-001). Evidence: the accepted, applying claims cited are supporting.
spec: contracts Part D causes_of §2, §3 (Lifting, one hop), §6
uncertainty: applies for a description-level claim with no linked occurrence is taken from the literal rule 'True otherwise' (ambiguities.md A-03).

competency: C1 stated causes: causal-claim judgements for one effect occurrence: accepted, polarity-disputed, unreviewed and denied
question: What caused occurrence o-outage, according to the system at T15, and how is each causal claim judged?
justification: Four causal claim contents name o-outage as effect; one entry per claim content with all its attestations (causes_of §5). cc-gen: the system's own assertion, accepted. o-pipe: the system's assertion cc-pipe and the auditor's denial cc-pipe-deny, accepted by the system: 'an accepted assertion plus an accepted denial is disputed' (§3), status DISPUTED (common 0.3). o-valve: only the inspector's claim, which the system never accepted: unreviewed, and unreviewed claims never decide. o-rat: the contractor's assertion is unreviewed (never decides); the system's own denial cc-rat-deny decides: denied. All players are occurrences: level occurrence, not lifted. Evidence (§6): cc-gen supporting (accepted, applies True since o-gen and o-outage have accepted existence); cc-rat-deny supporting for the question about that claim's denied judgement; cc-pipe and cc-pipe-deny conflicting (judgement disputed); cc-valve and cc-rat are unaccepted attestations, alternatives, never cited.

competency: C1 stated causes from another perspective: the inspector's own claim is accepted for the inspector, the system's claims are unreviewed there, and occurrence statuses follow the inspector's perspective
question: From the inspector's perspective at T15, what caused o-outage, and what is the status of the occurrences in the inspector's claim?
justification: The inspector's perspective is its own attestations plus its acceptances (v0.2 §5.3, §6.2); nothing is merged across perspectives (common 0.2). cc-valve is the inspector's own claim: accepted. Every other attestation (system, auditor, contractor) has no acceptance by the inspector: unreviewed, and unreviewed claims never decide (causes_of §3), so cc-gen, the o-pipe claim (both its assertion and its denial unreviewed) and the o-rat claim are unreviewed. Occurrence statuses are judged for the perspective (§1, §4) only from the occurrence's own existence attestations (shared rules, SB Occ-1); the only existence claims (ex-valve, ex-outage) are the system's, unaccepted by the inspector, so neither occurrence is accepted, denied or disputed: 'not established'. applies: no involved occurrence is denied or disputed, so True. Evidence: cc-valve supporting (accepted, applies True); all others are alternatives for this perspective and are never cited.

justification: One effect claim content (e-jam, initiates, classified-as(press-4, cat-jammed)): one entry (effects_of §5). ce-jam is the system's own claim: accepted. accepted_change uses changes() world-state transitions (SD-CAU-1): s1: the system's denial deny-jam holds over [T1, T6) and its assertion att-jam from T6 until superseded, so at T6 the content goes from an accepted 'does not hold' to holds: a world-state transition (changes §3, Q-B1.2), certain at T6, not before e-jam's start T5h20 (B-time). accepted_change True. s2: at @pre-obs att-jam is not yet recorded (common 0.2); after the denial's end at T6 nothing decides: False then UNKNOWN is a judgement transition, not an accepted change (SD-CAU-1: UNKNOWN transitions are not accepted changes): accepted_change False. The claim is timeless and visible at both knowledge times: accepted. Evidence: ce-jam supporting for the claim; the state attestations may be cited as state support; claim and state evidence never support each other. ce-kick is another event's claim about the same outcome, not reported (P-EF-1).
uncertainty: Only accepted_change is expected for the state: the instants at which state.before and state.after are judged are not fixed (GAP-MULTI-2; ambiguities.md A-07).
